name: Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the statute and funding of European political parties and European political foundations (recast)
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on new rules for European political parties and foundations. It tightens how they are funded and how transparent they must be. It adds a new income category called "association fees" from partners outside the European Union, caps other income, and requires parties to publish more about their money, advertising and gender balance. It also rewrites the rules for removing a party from the official register, including for breaking European Union values.

- New income rules: association fees allowed, other income capped at 10 percent of contributions and fees.
- Affects European political parties and foundations, their members and donors.
- Next: Parliament negotiates the final text with European Union governments.
